items.title: Japan's Nikkei slumps as chip selloff, geopolitical tensions dent risk appetite
items.description: Japan's Nikkei share average declined 1.3% on Thursday, impacted by a selloff in chip-related stocks. Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions fueled inflation concerns, leading investors to avoid risky assets. SoftBank Group was a significant drag on the index, contributing to the broader market downturn.

items.title: Stocks in news: Lenskart, PFC, RIL, Hindustan Zinc, Tata Consumer
items.description: Indian markets saw volatile trading on Wednesday, closing slightly down. Lenskart, PFC, RIL, Hindustan Zinc, and Tata Consumer are in focus. ADIA plans to sell Lenskart shares. Tata Consumer targets over 20% EBITDA margin. Reliance Industries subsidiary will redevelop a Mumbai slum. REC Ltd will merge with Power Finance Corporation. ZEEL plans to raise funds.

items.title: Gift Nifty signals a negative start; here's the trading setup for the day
items.description: Nifty closed flat on Wednesday as easing crude prices boosted domestic consumption stocks and defensive sectors. Investor sentiment is stabilizing, with hopes for a resolution to the Israel-Iran conflict improving confidence. However, Gift Nifty signals a negative start, and oil prices climbed amid escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Dwarikesh Sugar, Dhampur Sugar and other sugar stocks gain up to 4% after excise duty cut on ethanol-blended petrol
items.description: Sugar stocks rose sharply on Thursday after the Finance Ministry exempted several ethanol-blended petrol variants from excise duty, strengthening the outlook for India's ethanol blending programme. Investors cheered the move as it is expected to boost ethanol demand, improve earnings visibility for sugar companies, and support long-term sector growth.

items.title: SpaceX IPO: Know date, price, valuation, how to buy and other important details
items.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is preparing for what could become the largest initial public offering in history, with the rocket and satellite giant seeking to raise $75 billion at a valuation of about $1.75 trillion. Investor appetite has been overwhelming, with demand reportedly running at nearly four times the shares on offer, per Reuters. Here are important details investors should know.

items.title: F&O Radar: Call Ratio Spread strategy for ICICI Bank this week
items.description: ICICI Bank shows a sustained uptrend with bullish technical indicators including higher highs, strong RSI and a weekly hammer pattern. Analysts suggest a call ratio spread strategy for June expiry, with defined risk and reward levels, as the stock trades near key resistance zones with continued buying interest.

items.title: Sweet pills: How pharma stocks delivered bumper returns to Indian investors, defying 2026 whiplash
items.description: Indian pharma stocks are outperforming the market, offering strong returns to investors. This resilience is driven by robust domestic demand and positive global healthcare trends. Analysts see long-term growth potential from aging populations and innovation. Emerging opportunities from supply chain diversification away from China also present a positive outlook for Indian pharmaceutical companies.

items.title: Honasa shares jump 6% on Rs 5,500 crore revenue target by FY31. What is Goldman Sachs saying?
items.description: Honasa Consumer shares surged after the company outlined a revenue target of ₹5,500 crore by FY31. The guidance implies an annual growth rate of around 18% between FY26 and FY31. Growth is expected to be led by Mamaearth, with revenue projected to exceed ₹2,000 crore, while The Derma Co is expected to contribute nearly ₹1,500 crore by FY31.

items.title: Oil India among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of June 10, there was a notable surge in futures open interest in five stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase of over 7% compared to the previous trading session. A significant uptick in futures open interest signifies a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a specific security. This uptrend reflects an increasing number of participants either initiating new positions or expanding existing positions in the futures market.

items.title: Zee Entertainment shares rise over 3% ahead of FIFA World Cup, Rs 2,300-crore fundraising plans
items.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises' shares rose after its board approved raising at least Rs 2,300 crore to fund strategic initiatives and bolster its balance sheet. The media company also secured exclusive rights for FIFA events until 2034, including the 2026 and 2030 World Cups, amidst a challenging March quarter financial performance.

items.title: Wipro's Rs 15,000 crore buyback opens today: Analysts expect 7-8% returns for retail investors. Here's how
items.description: Wipro's significant Rs 15,000 crore share buyback has commenced. Eligible shareholders can tender shares at Rs 250, a substantial premium to the current market price. This corporate action provides an opportunity for investors to realize profits. The buyback period runs from June 10 to June 17. Shareholders should ensure their accounts are active for smooth transactions.

items.title: Sensex tumbles 350 points, Nifty below 23,150 as Iran shuts Strait of Hormuz after US strikes. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian stock markets experienced a downturn on Thursday, with Sensex and Nifty both declining by 0.6%. Renewed Middle East tensions and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz led to a spike in oil prices, unsettling investors. Major indices and broader markets saw losses, with IT and Auto sectors leading the decline.

items.title: Bonus bonanza! Last date to buy City Union Bank shares for 1:3 reward
items.description: City Union Bank Bonus Issue: June 11 is the last day for investors to buy shares of City Union Bank to qualify for its 1:3 bonus issue, as the record date has been fixed for June 12. Under SEBI’s T+1 settlement cycle, shares purchased today will be credited to investors’ demat accounts by the record date, making them eligible to receive one bonus share for every three shares held.

items.title: Dividend rush! Buy these 5 Adani stocks, 4 Tata Group stocks today to lap up payout rewards
items.description: More than 30 companies, including five Adani Group firms and four Tata Group companies, have fixed June 12 as the record date for dividend payouts totaling nearly ₹300 per share. Investors looking to qualify for these dividends must buy the shares by June 11.

items.title: Lenskart Solutions sees Rs 1,862-crore block deal; ADIA likely seller
items.description: Eyewear retailer Lenskart Solutions experienced a significant block deal valued at Rs 1,862 crore. Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, through its investment vehicle, sold a portion of its shares. This follows a similar stake sale by SoftBank. Despite early investors reducing holdings, Lenskart's revenue surged in the January-March quarter. The company also reported strong full-year financial performance.

items.title: Kospi tanks 9% in just two sessions! What’s causing bloodbath in 2026’s top market?
items.description: South Korea’s KOSPI has plunged 9% in two sessions after a strong 2026 rally, as AI-driven semiconductor stocks face profit booking. Rising U.S. inflation, geopolitical tensions in West Asia and leveraged ETF volatility have intensified the sell-off, raising concerns that the AI-led rally may have outpaced fundamentals.

items.title: Exclusive | Why BSE wants options traders to think beyond the next expiry
items.description: After successfully reviving Sensex derivatives, BSE CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy is now focused on shifting traders from weekly options to longer-dated contracts. Over the next three years, the exchange aims to boost participation in monthly and farther-expiry options, which it believes provide better hedging and help reduce market volatility during global shocks.

items.title: Vahh Chemicals shares list at 17% premium over IPO price on BSE SME platform
items.description: Vahh Chemicals Listing: Vahh Chemicals debuted on the BSE SME platform with a nearly 17% premium, listing at Rs 70 against its IPO price of Rs 60. The Rs 13.45 crore IPO, fully subscribed 11.08 times, was driven by strong retail investor demand. The company manufactures textile auxiliary chemicals and also has a presence in the nutraceutical segment.

items.title: ​Chambal Fertilisers among 3 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On June 10, three Nifty500 stocks appeared on the White Marubozu bullish scanner according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis where the opening price is the lowest point of the session and the closing price is the highest.It is represented by a long white or green candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or no lower shadow, indicating strong buying pressure throughout the trading session. Traders interpret this as a signal that buyers remained in control from open to close, often using it to assess potential continuation of upward momentum in the near term.
